full_text_in_Indonesian: Kedua ancaman gempa bumi yang potensial di Jogja pertama zona tumpukan Lempeng Megathrust di selatan Jogja itu potensinya Magnitudo 8 7  di darat ada aktivitas sesar aktif yakni Sesar Opak yang bisa mencapai Magnitudo 6 6 " kata Kepala Pusat Gempa Bumi dan Tsunami BMKG  Daryono.
full_text_in_English: "The two potential earthquake threats in Jogja, the first is the Megathrust Plate Stack Zone in the south of Jogja, which has a potential magnitude of 8-7. On land, there is active fault activity, namely the Opak Fault, which can reach a magnitude of 6-6," said Head of the BMKG Earthquake and Tsunami Center, Daryono.

full_text_in_Indonesian: Daryono menerangkan  Bantul menjadi wilayah yang paling rawan terdampak gempa bumi lantaran karakteristik tanahnya yang lunak.  Hal ini bisa dilihat dari peristiwa gempa bumi 2006 yang sebagian besar wilayah Bantul mengalami rusak parah.
full_text_in_English: Daryono explained that Bantul is the area most prone to being affected by earthquakes because of its soft soil characteristics. This can be seen from the 2006 earthquake in which most of the Bantul area was badly damaged.

full_text_in_Indonesian: Menurut Daryono  yang perlu disiapkan untuk menghadapi ancaman gempa bumi ini adalah kesiapan masyarakat soal mitigasi.  Struktur bangunan rumah hendaknya dibangun berdasarkan pada tahan gempa atau terbuat dari kayu dan bambu.
full_text_in_English: According to Daryono, what needs to be prepared to face the threat of an earthquake is community readiness regarding mitigation. The structure of the house should be built to be earthquake resistant or made of wood and bamboo.
